name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Account Manager & AI-Driven Customer Success Leader

Builds AI-driven systems daily, from autonomous agent workflows to structured LLM prompting, that treat account and lead management as a systems problem, the same AI-first approach this role calls for. Comfortable translating complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and executives.

Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, identifying opportunities to expand retainer scope and scoping complementary services aligned with client objectives.

bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
